questions.question: Factor: x² - 9x + 20
questions.explanation: Need two numbers that multiply to 20 and add to -9: -4 and -5. So (x - 4)(x - 5).
steps: 1. Find factors of 20 that sum to -9.
questions.fastStrategy: For x² + bx + c, find two numbers multiply to c, add to b.

questions.question: Factor: 3x² + 9x + 6
questions.explanation: Factor out GCF 3: 3(x² + 3x + 2). Then factor trinomial: 3(x + 1)(x + 2).
steps: 2. Factor trinomial: find numbers multiply to 2, add to 3 → 1 and 2.
questions.fastStrategy: Always factor out GCF first, then factor remaining expression.

questions.question: Factor: x² - 16
steps: 1. Recognize difference of squares: a² - b².
questions.fastStrategy: Difference of squares: a² - b² = (a - b)(a + b).

questions.question: Factor: x³ - 27
questions.explanation: Difference of cubes: a³ - b³ = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²). So x³ - 3³ = (x - 3)(x² + 3x + 9).
steps: 1. Recognize difference of cubes: x³ - 27 = x³ - 3³.
questions.fastStrategy: Difference of cubes: a³ - b³ = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²).

questions.question: Factor: 4x² - 12x
questions.fastStrategy: Factor out greatest common factor (GCF) first.
